reasons.plausibility: The mechanism of lattice distortion affecting dislocation motion in HEAs is well-grounded, though there may be minor complexities (e.g., short-range ordering, precipitates) not fully addressed.
reasons.testability: A clear experiment comparing equimolar and non-equimolar variants under the same conditions can decisively validate or refute the proposed link between lattice distortion and mechanical properties.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly focuses on a key determinant of hardness and strength in CoCrFeNiTi and provides a practical route to verify its significance through controlled composition changes.
